Matched to the published p100 row by invocation, by -t 2, and by sequence content — but NOT by artefact: the published run used the Singularity sandbox binary (638,912 bytes) and this used a local micromamba install (573,672 bytes); the two are different files that both self-report 1.2.1, so the version match is a self-reported string. The FASTAs carry the same 3,209,286,105 bases under different accession headers. Author-cancelled incomplete after 1 d 22 h 15 m; its elapsed is at least 1.55x the completed 29.8 h p100 run, a lower bound on a terminated run and not a speed ratio. 138,425 complete records plus one truncated fragment, all on chr1 (NC_000001.11); the last complete record ends at 124,785,432 and the fragment's End field reads 124,786,615. Output stopped growing for the final 5 h; the LAST EMITTED position lies in the chr1 centromeric satellite, which is not evidence about where the stall itself occurred. lines=138426 is a newline count including the header. Partial TSV, not scored. Evidence: results/range_cost_attempts/ultra_p2000/
